The alternating hypothesis HELD: idx 0 = cover, idx 1 = Hindi General Instructions + Hindi Q1, idx 2 = English General Instructions + English Q1, and thereafter every odd index is the Hindi mirror of the even index that follows it. Verified directly on idx 21 (Hindi, 'Page 22 of 24') against idx 22 (English, 'Page 23 of 24'), not only from the contact sheet. idx 23 is 'Page 24 of 24' and is BLANK apart from the footer '65/4/1/21/QSS4R 207 A' — so 24 pages, 23 printed. STRUCTURE: full80 confirmed by the printed instructions — 38 questions, Q1-18 MCQ + Q19-20 Assertion-Reason @1, Q21-25 @2, Q26-31 @3, Q32-35 @5, Q36-38 case study @4. Internal choice is printed as '2 questions in Section B, 3 questions in Section C, 3 questions in Section D and 2 questions in Section E' = TEN alternative pairs (Q21, Q22, Q27, Q29, Q31, Q32, Q33, Q35, Q37(iii), Q38(iii)), one more than the nine the brief describes. TYPOGRAPHY: option labels are UPPER case in parentheses — (A) (B) (C) (D). Decimal points are ORDINARY full stops, not the raised dot seen on some sittings; the only decimals in the whole paper are the 0.1 entries in Q17's probability table (ordinary in the question paper AND in the marking scheme). CASE STUDIES: no 'Case Study - N' headings are printed anywhere — Q36/37/38 simply begin with the passage, so no row carries _caseStudyLabel. Q36 has only TWO sub-parts and no internal choice (see its _flag); Q37 and Q38 have (i)/(ii)/(iii) with an OR on (iii). MARKING SCHEME: rendered as ordinary TEXT, not images — every 'Ans' row for Q1-Q20 was read as text, unlike the 2025 series-65/4 scheme. All 20 MCQ answers are the official key verbatim; no disagreement with my own derivation was found. plan.txt says 'No reference papers given - transcribe every question', so nothing was skipped and every question of the sitting is present.
